description: Source code for utility functions related to Visual Studio configuration, including parsing compiler and linker options, and generating GUIDs, used within Chromium project.

methods.name: MakeGuid
methods.description: Generates a GUID string based on entry path and seed using MD5 hash.

methods.name: ParseCompilerOption
methods.description: Parses a compiler flag string and updates CompilerOptions accordingly.

methods.name: ParseLinkerOption
methods.description: Parses a linker flag string and updates LinkerOptions accordingly.
